description: The same two-subsystem task on a small window, so main and its line compact and must still know which line they are
message:
Two independent subsystems need building in this project, and each has its own failing test suite:

- parser/ — the integer expression parser specified in parser/expr.py
- cache/ — the bounded LRU cache with TTL specified in cache/lru.py

They share no code and do not touch the same files. Make `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` pass for both, and keep the implementations to their specs.

probes.text: after a compaction, main's next request still carries its roster of open lines and a line's next request still carries its own identity block
after a compaction a line acts as if it were main or forgets which line it is
